name: community platform
say: Reason five: it's a platform shaped like a community. Domains are modules: a cigar journal with a flavor wheel and a full 3D lounge. Arcade games. Tutorial courses. Embedded websites, published straight from tiles. All of them are bees and layers — which means all of them are forkable, shareable, and yours to remix. The distance between a user and a developer collapses to a signature.
